verdict.rationale: Docs confirm financial accounts can be created and funded via API (money_manager configuration, OutboundPayments, Connect flows), but the evidence pack never states that these accounts are FDIC-insured deposit accounts, nor does it mention any sandbox/test-mode parity for the Treasury account-opening flow. missing for 10: explicit FDIC/insurance documentation, sandbox-vs-production parity evidence, full automated 'application to active account' onboarding details.
